lines.text: Done, and the verdict is a handshake! {managerA} and {managerB} cannot be split!
Nobody wins it, nobody loses it, and {clubA} and {clubB} walk off together!
Level at the very end! {managerA} matched the rival stride for stride, right to the line!
Winner? There isn't one, because this Showdown refuses to pick a side.
What a way to finish: a perfect stalemate between old friends, and nobody can complain!
On one shoulder {clubA}, on the other {clubB}, and the scales will not tip!
They came to settle it, and they leave it settled the only fair way: together.
Dead level on the line, {managerA}! {managerB} would not let go for a single season!
Nothing to separate {clubA} from {clubB} when it matters most, and what a story that is.
Shared sunrise at the end of a long road, and {managerA} wears it as proudly as anyone.
Stand and applaud the pair of them, because neither blinked!
No winner today, but a rivalry that just got deeper, and that is worth more than silverware.
Level on {points} apiece, and the Showdown closes with a smile.
Pull the ribbons off both ends of the table, because {clubB} and {clubA} finish as equals.
This one goes to nobody, and somehow that feels exactly right.
{managerB} looks across at the rival, the rival looks back, and there is nothing but respect.
History will write one word beside this Showdown: level!
After all that, after every season, {clubA} and {clubB} are still inseparable.
Both cabinets are full of stories, and neither can claim the last page.
Rarest ending of all, a dead heat, and {managerB} has made it theirs.
Call it what it is: a masterpiece of balance from {managerA} and {managerB}.
Final whistle, and neither {clubA} nor {clubB} has been beaten!
Hardly a hair between them. This is as close as a Showdown can get.
Put the champagne away, or open it for everyone, because {managerA} shares this one.
Honors even in the end, and {clubB} can hold its head high beside {clubA}.
They traded blows season after season, and the table finally says what the rivalry always knew: equal!
Level, level, level. {managerA} has run this Showdown to a standstill.
What are the odds? A whole Showdown, and not a point between {clubA} and {clubB}!
This is the sort of ending you tell your grandchildren about, and nobody even lost.
{managerA}, take a bow. {managerB}, take a bow. This Showdown has no winner and no loser!
Different clubs, one finish line, and they cross it together.
Rivalry this good deserves an ending this fair, and {clubA} and {clubB} have delivered it!
Quiet follows, full of respect for {managerB}, and the Showdown stays level.
Absolutely nothing in it at the finish, {points} each.
Old friends wrote this story, and the last line reads: shared!
Neither crown nor collapse, just {managerA} and {managerB} meeting exactly in the middle!
Always going to come down to the wire, and the wire says: both!
From the first season to the last, {clubA} never let {clubB} go, and here is the proof!
Break out the biggest smile you have. Nothing between {managerA} and {managerB} at the finish.
Finish for the ages, and the age-old question has the same answer: neither!
No one climbs the podium alone this time, {managerB}.
Books balance at last, and {clubA} and {clubB} sign the page together!
Quiet falls, then it sinks in: this Showdown is a draw, and {clubA} is fine with that!
Imagine the effort it takes to finish exactly level. {managerA} just did it.
All that fight and all that glory, and it ends on a hug instead of a hoist.
Neither flag goes up the pole, and honestly, who needs one?
If you wanted a hero, you will have to share one. {managerA} and {managerB} are the story!
Final page turns, and {clubB} and {clubA} are still locked together!
Stalemate, and what a glorious one! Not a point of daylight between them!
{clubA} can look {clubB} in the eye, and {clubB} can look right back.
Could have broken either way, and it broke neither. A draw, and a deserved one.
{managerA} will say they should have won it, {managerB} will say the same, and both are right!
When the dust settles, there are no losers standing, only {clubA} and {clubB}, shoulder to shoulder.
Honest to goodness, you could not slide a sheet of paper between them!
This Showdown ends the way the best friendships do, with nobody ahead.
Sign-off time, and the rivalry stays alive because nobody got the last word!
Even the trophy cabinet looks confused. {managerA} is dead level with the rival!
Glory is shared and honor is intact, and {clubA} walks away smiling.
They said somebody would crack. Nobody did. The Showdown ends level.
Photo finish, and the photograph shows {managerA} and {managerB} arm in arm!
Nobody ordered this ending, but everybody will remember it.
Neither side blinked, neither side broke, and {clubB} stands as an equal of {clubA}.
Everything this Showdown had, and one last gift to finish: a draw!
Hand on heart, {managerB}, you could not have asked for a closer fight!
Season after season it ebbed and flowed, and in the end the tide went out exactly level.
Let it ring out across the living room: no winner, no loser, and a rivalry still going strong.
All square! Nothing can separate {clubA} from {clubB}, not even a whole Showdown!
And that, ladies and gentlemen, is a draw, shared by {managerA} and {managerB}!
Perfectly balanced, and not by accident. {managerB} earned every bit of this.
{managerA} holds the line, {managerB} holds the line, and the line holds!
No open-top bus for either side, but {clubA} and {clubB} can share the road home.
Another Showdown, another classic, and this time the finish is shared.
Look at the final tally and look again. It still says level!
A draw like this is no failure of nerve; it is a monument to {managerA} and {managerB}.
Give them all the applause, because this Showdown has left nothing to choose between {clubA} and {clubB}.
Neither name goes on the roll of honor alone, and that is a rare sight indeed.
Took every season to find out, and the answer is: they are the same!
Everything {clubA} had and everything {clubB} had came out exactly even.
Settled, finally, and settled in the fairest way possible. Level!
Some stories end with a roar. This one ends with a long, warm sigh from {managerB}.
The wait is over and the answer is a shrug, a grin, and a raised glass from {managerA}.
If this Showdown were a boxing match, the judges would throw up their hands!
You could not write it, and nobody would believe it if you did: {clubA} and {clubB}, level to the last!
No trophy to lift today, but plenty to be proud of, {managerA}.
The headline writes itself, and it says level! {managerB} may want it framed!
Remember this one, because a Showdown this tight does not come around often.
{managerB} pushed, {managerA} pushed back, and the Showdown stood perfectly still.
It ends the way it began, with rivals and a point to prove, and neither proved it more than the other.
What a standoff! {clubA} against {clubB} until the very last second, and nothing in it!
The great Showdown finishes in a dead heat, and it is a thing of beauty!
If there is a sweeter way to end a rivalry than level, nobody has found it!
They set out to settle it, and the answer comes back the same for both: level.
Deserved to win it, {managerA} did. So did {managerB}. The Showdown agreed with both!
Close the book gently, because this chapter belongs to {clubA} and {clubB} equally.
And there it is, the draw nobody could call and everybody will remember!
A mountain climbed together, and the summit has room for {managerA} and {managerB}!
Over {seasons} seasons they could not be parted, and now they never will be!
The last word on this Showdown is not a name. It is a draw!
Shake hands, {managerA}, and let the next Showdown begin whenever you are ready!
Sit back, breathe out, and savor it, because {clubA} and {clubB} have given us a dead-even classic!
